canada.title: Alberta government to standardize report cards, require more information on professional development days
canada.summary: The Alberta government has introduced new legislation aimed at standardizing how local school authorities craft report cards for students.

canada.title: Dawson City, Yukon, leaders urge territory to retract no-cause eviction bill
canada.summary: Some Yukoners are asking the territorial government to rethink amendments to the Residential Tenancies Act. Specifically, bringing back no-cause evictions. Bill 8 was passed in the Yukon Legislature Tuesday.

canada.title: Royal Newfoundland Constabulary reviewing partnership with Crime Stoppers after data breach
canada.summary: The Royal Newfoundland Constabulary is reviewing its partnership with anonymous tip service Crime Stoppers after it was reported over 1.5 million tips submitted to Canadian Crime Stoppers programs were exposed publicly in a data breach. Const. Stephanie Myers says Crime Stoppers operates independently from the RNC, so any personal information gathered is never shared with police.

canada.title: New details emerge in death of 4-year-old Inuk girl in care of Montreal youth protection
canada.summary: Quebec’s health authority has launched a major investigation into the care of Montreal's English youth protection system after three deaths of children in their care in March 2026.

canada.title: Iris Kirby House shelter closes after flood, N.L. government vows to support residents
canada.summary: The shelter at Iris Kirby House in St. John's is closed following a serious flood, according to a social media post published Wednesday night.

canada.title: Proposed new residential development in Whitehorse clears another hurdle
canada.summary: Whitehorse city council this week passed a master plan for the proposed Highland Estates residential development, near the Lobird mobile home park. It could eventually include 16 residential building lots, each about an acre.

canada.title: Inquest into death of Regis Korchinski-Paquet on hold for investigation: coroner
canada.summary: A coroner’s inquest into the death of a Toronto woman who fell from a 24th-floor balcony while police were in her home was put on hold indefinitely Thursday just as it reached the final stretch of the proceedings.

canada.title: Maya Gebala released from hospital 262 days after Tumbler Ridge shooting
canada.summary: "262 days since we were told, “We did everything we could, but we don’t think she’s going to make it through the night'," David Gebala wrote on Thursday.

canada.title: Cape Breton auto salvage dealer granted bail after fleeing from police
canada.summary: Sandy Joseph Young is facing dozens of charges for weapons and stolen vehicles in what Cape Breton Regional Police say is a collaboration with insurance fraud investigators from Montreal.

canada.title: Murder charges laid in Regina woman's death
canada.summary: Police have charged Destinee Villebrun, 41, and a 17-year old with second-degree murder in the death of Rebecca Autumn (Wilson) Mathieson, 37, who was found seriously injured in an alley on Aug. 14 and died on Aug. 30.

canada.title: Montreal police explain day-long delay in dismantling unit accused of misconduct
canada.summary: A 16-member patrol unit remained armed and active for nearly a full day after investigations secured enough evidence to take action against officers accused of criminal misconduct.

canada.title: Ottawa quietly abandoned its promise to end thermal coal exports, auditor finds
canada.summary: A report from the federal auditor general published Thursday reveals Environment and Climate Change Canada quietly gave up on its plans to end thermal coal exports years ago without notifying the public and without record of being directed a do so.

canada.title: Officer shot in Belleville synagogue attack released from hospital
canada.summary: Police in Belleville say an officer who was shot on Yom Kippur while protecting a synagogue full of worshippers from an armed attacker has been released from the hospital.

canada.title: Kevin Falcon resigns as B.C. United leader after party officially deregistered
canada.summary: Former British Columbia opposition leader Kevin Falcon has stepped down as head of the deregistered B.C. United party, two years after it folded its 2024 election campaign to support the provincial Conservatives.

canada.title: High-risk sex offender released, expected to live in Winnipeg
canada.summary: Convicted sex offender Douglas Wayne Bowman, 62, has been released after a lengthy prison sentence, and Winnipeg police are warning the public he is considered a high risk to reoffend.

canada.title: Halifax police board calls for return of RCMP offices, explores municipal police stepping in
canada.summary: Halifax’s police board is calling for the RCMP to create permanent community policing offices the city already approved, and will explore whether a municipal force could step in instead.

canada.title: Fire at New Brunswick military base not threat to public: defence officials
canada.summary: The Department of National Defence says the blaze in the northeastern part of the Canadian Forces Base Gagetown training area is being monitored.

canada.title: 'It feels fantastic,' Scott Gillingham says after winning another term as Winnipeg mayor
canada.summary: After winning his second consecutive term as Winnipeg mayor, Scott Gillingham says the city's best days are still to come. He had 39.8 per cent of the ballots cast, with all polls reporting just before 10 p.m. Wednesday.
